contexts.text: Thou shalt make a plate of pure gold () = illustration from the Lord's Divine good. A plate = illustration... The reason a plate = illustration, was from its resplendence; for it was resplendent with gold upon Aaron's forehead...
As by the plate was signified illustration from the Lord's Divine good, it was called the plate of the crown of holiness, and also the crown of holiness. Illustrated. AR 189:3.
The reason Holiness to Jehovah was engraved on the plate of gold...
As the forehead = love, it is said of the plate that... AE 427:7.
That a crown = Divine good from which is Divine truth, was represented by the plate of gold... which plate was also called a crown, and a coronet. Illustrated.
